title: Voyager 1 launched; later the first probe in interstellar space
summary: NASA launched the Voyager 1 probe on 5 September 1977 from Cape Canaveral on a Titan IIIE-Centaur rocket. It flew past Jupiter and Saturn, and in August 2012 crossed the heliopause, becoming the first spacecraft to enter interstellar space; NASA confirmed this in September 2013.

uncertainty.note: Launch date is exact. Heliopause crossing is dated 25 August 2012 by Wikipedia (the date durable particle-density changes were first seen); NASA says only August 2012.
